<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix vocab: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .

vocab:FrameAttachmentRecordShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass vocab:frameAttachmentRecord ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:frameShellWeldType ;
        sh:hasValue vocab:doubleContinuousWeld ;
        sh:message "The frame must be attached to the shell by a double continuous weld (TRF‑050 §4.4.4.2)." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:scallopingPresent ;
        sh:datatype xsd:boolean ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:message "Scalloping presence flag must be provided (boolean)." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:shellPlateButtCrossing ;
        sh:datatype xsd:boolean ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:message "Shell‑plate‑butt crossing flag must be provided (boolean)." ;
    ] ;
    ## Conditional rule: scalloping is allowed only when crossing a shell‑plate butt
    sh:if [
        sh:property [
            sh:path vocab:scallopingPresent ;
            sh:hasValue true ;
        ]
    ] ;
    sh:then [
        sh:property [
            sh:path vocab:shellPlateButtCrossing ;
            sh:hasValue true ;
            sh:message "If scalloping is present, the case must be an exception where the frame crosses a shell‑plate butt (TRF‑050 §4.4.4.2)." ;
        ]
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
